gsc_guide.summary: All 3 domains already have google-site-verification DNS TXT records (2 each), meaning GSC properties were likely already added. Steps below are for verification/re-verification if needed.

steps.title: Open Google Search Console
steps.notes: Sign in with your Google account (the one you want to own the properties)

steps.title: Add Property (URL Prefix method)
steps.action: Click 'Add property' in the left sidebar dropdown. Choose 'URL prefix'. Enter https://ingredientcalculator.com (repeat for each domain).
steps.notes: URL prefix is simpler than Domain property. Use https:// prefix since all 3 sites serve HTTPS.

steps.title: Verify via DNS TXT Record
steps.action: GSC will show a verification code like google-site-verification=XXXXX. Go to Cloudflare Dashboard > select domain > DNS > Records > Add Record. Type: TXT, Name: @, Content: paste the verification string. TTL: Auto.
steps.notes: ALL 3 DOMAINS ALREADY HAVE google-site-verification TXT records. If they belong to your Google account, verification should auto-complete. If they belong to a different account, you need to add a NEW TXT record with the new verification code.

steps.title: Submit Sitemap
steps.action: In GSC, go to Sitemaps (left sidebar). Enter 'sitemap.xml' and click Submit. Also try 'sitemap_index.xml' if applicable.
steps.notes: If sites are Cloudflare Pages with static content, ensure sitemap.xml exists in the build output.

steps.title: Check Impressions and Clicks
steps.action: GSC Performance tab shows impressions, clicks, CTR, position. Data takes 2-3 days to appear for new properties.
steps.notes: For newly acquired domains, check if there is historical data from previous owners. GSC data resets when ownership changes.

steps.title: Request Indexing (optional)
steps.action: Use URL Inspection tool in GSC. Paste homepage URL and click 'Request Indexing'. Do this for key pages.
steps.notes: Limited to ~10-20 requests per day. Prioritize homepage and high-value pages.
